title: UW Markdown Cash Flow Series Section
description: Content payload for the `cash_flow_series` section (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4.26, RFC 0034). A dated, irregular cash-flow series — ISO-8601 calendar dates, signed amounts — with optional stated aggregates (total_net, moic, xnpv at a rate, xirr). This is a state-and-verify structure (RFC 0021 §6, the `capital_stack` / `lease_up_schedule` precedent): the Tier-3 calc engine never reads it, so a variable-length array is safe, and every stated metric is recomputed by `verifyCashFlowSeries` over the Protocol §VIII.9 procedures rather than trusted. This schema enforces structure only. The cross-field rules a validator/verifier adds are: real calendar days and finite amounts with registered enums (CF-01); a non-empty series with non-decreasing dates whose first row anchors every year fraction (CF-02); a stated xirr requiring at least one negative and one positive amount (CF-03); and each stated metric recomputing at its quantization boundary or the verdict is `failed`.

_meta.description: Standard block provenance envelope (§2.5). Not constrained here.

label.description: Free-text name for the series (e.g. "Levered hold-period cash flow").

day_count.description: Day-count convention from the closed Protocol §VIII.9.1 registry; `actual/365f` when absent. `30/360us` is exactly the Excel DAYS360 U.S. method (no NASD February special-casing). An unknown convention is CF-01, never a default.

series.description: The dated flows, one entry per flow, dates non-decreasing (CF-02). The first row's date is the anchor. Same-day flows are legal and are not merged. Stated data, not formulas: the calc engine never iterates it; rows remain addressable by path (e.g. `cash_flow_series.series[3].amount`).

stated_metrics.description: The stated aggregates, each verified when present (three-state; Protocol §VIII.9.4 quanta: currency 2dp, rate 6dp, ratio 4dp). A metric absent here is simply not checked.

moic.description: Σ inflows ÷ |Σ outflows|. Unverifiable (never failed) on a series with no outflows.

xnpv.description: Net present value at a stated discount rate, per Protocol §VIII.9.2 (closed-form, anchor-relative exponents under the declared day_count).

rate.description: Discount rate as a fraction (0.06, never 6).

xirr.description: Annualized internal rate of return as a fraction, per the Protocol §VIII.9.3 procedure (the RFC 0024 bisection over date-derived exponents). Requires a sign change in the series (CF-03).

date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must name a real day — 2026-02-30 is CF-01 (the pattern alone cannot check month lengths).

kind.description: Advisory taxonomy for renderers and rollups; gates no rule (§4.26).
